title: Eldritch Battery
text:
Eldritch Battery is a keystone passive skill that converts your energy shield into mana and doubles the mana cost of skills. 


== Mechanics ==
This keystone converts your base energy shield (the sum of sources of flat energy shield) into base mana. This conversion applies before any modifiers, such as #% increased/more Mana. This mana will not scale with modifiers to energy shield (e.g. #% increased/more Energy Shield).


== Location ==
Eldritch Battery is located on the top side of the passive skill tree.


== Related unique items ==
These unique items have the Eldritch Battery modifier, which grants the effect of this keystone. This effect does not double up by also having the keystone allocated.
